hints: Resolve the three forces along the horizontal line $ABC$ and perpendicular to it.
Use Pythagoras' theorem $R = \sqrt{X^2 + Y^2}$ for magnitude and $\tan\theta = \frac{|Y|}{|X|}$ to specify the direction.
walkthrough:
Resolve the three forces along the line $ABC$ (taking direction $BA$ as positive):
$$X = 25\cos 30^\circ - 15\cos 40^\circ = 25\left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right) - 15\cos 40^\circ \approx 21.6506 - 11.4907 = 10.1599\text{ N}$$

Resolve the forces perpendicular to $ABC$ (taking upwards as positive):
$$Y = 25\sin 30^\circ + 15\sin 40^\circ - 30 = 12.5 + 9.6418 - 30 = -7.8582\text{ N}$$

Calculate the magnitude of the resultant force:
$$R = \sqrt{X^2 + Y^2} = \sqrt{10.1599^2 + (-7.8582)^2} = \sqrt{103.224 + 61.751} = \sqrt{164.975} \approx 12.8\text{ N}$$

Find the direction angle $\theta$ below the horizontal:
$$\tan\theta = \frac{|Y|}{|X|} = \frac{7.8582}{10.1599} \approx 0.77345 \implies \theta = \tan^{-1}(0.77345) \approx 37.7^\circ$$
The resultant acts at $37.7^\circ$ below the horizontal in the direction $BA$.
teacher_walkthrough: Establish coordinate axes with the $x$-axis along the line $ABC$ in the direction of $BA$, and the $y$-axis pointing upwards perpendicular to $ABC$.

Resolve the forces along the $x$-axis:
$$X = 25\cos 30^\circ - 15\cos 40^\circ$$
Evaluate each trigonometric value:
$$25\cos 30^\circ = 25 \times 0.866025 = 21.6506\text{ N}$$
$$15\cos 40^\circ = 15 \times 0.766044 = 11.4907\text{ N}$$
$$X = 21.6506 - 11.4907 = 10.1599\text{ N}$$

Resolve the forces along the $y$-axis:
$$Y = 25\sin 30^\circ + 15\sin 40^\circ - 30$$
Evaluate each trigonometric value:
$$25\sin 30^\circ = 25 \times 0.5 = 12.5\text{ N}$$
$$15\sin 40^\circ = 15 \times 0.642788 = 9.6418\text{ N}$$
$$Y = 12.5 + 9.6418 - 30 = 22.1418 - 30 = -7.8582\text{ N}$$

Calculate the resultant magnitude using Pythagoras' theorem:
$$R = \sqrt{X^2 + Y^2}$$
$$X^2 = 10.1599^2 \approx 103.224$$
$$Y^2 = (-7.8582)^2 \approx 61.751$$
$$R = \sqrt{103.224 + 61.751} = \sqrt{164.975} \approx 12.844\text{ N} \approx 12.8\text{ N}$$

Calculate the direction angle $\theta$ below the horizontal line $BA$:
$$\tan\theta = \frac{|Y|}{X} = \frac{7.8582}{10.1599} \approx 0.77345$$
$$\theta = \tan^{-1}(0.77345) \approx 37.72^\circ \approx 37.7^\circ$$
The resultant force has magnitude $12.8\text{ N}$ directed $37.7^\circ$ below the horizontal in the direction $BA$.

ai_rubric.Resolving Forces Along Chosen Axes: Resolves forces to obtain $X = 10.16\text{ N}$ and $Y = -7.86\text{ N}$, finding resultant magnitude $12.8\text{ N}$ and direction $37.7^\circ$ below horizontal in direction $BA$.

hints: For the resultant to be perpendicular to $ABC$, the net component along the line $ABC$ must be zero: $F\cos 40^\circ = 25\cos 30^\circ$.
Calculate the new vertical component: $Y_{\text{new}} = F\sin 40^\circ + 25\sin 30^\circ - 30$ to find the new resultant force.
walkthrough:
Since the new resultant is perpendicular to the line $ABC$, the horizontal component must be zero:
$$F\cos 40^\circ = 25\cos 30^\circ$$
$$F = \frac{25\cos 30^\circ}{\cos 40^\circ} = \frac{21.6506}{0.766044} \approx 28.2628\text{ N} \approx 28.3\text{ N}$$

Evaluate the new vertical component which forms the entire resultant:
$$R_{\text{new}} = F\sin 40^\circ + 25\sin 30^\circ - 30$$
$$R_{\text{new}} = (28.2628)\sin 40^\circ + 12.5 - 30$$
$$R_{\text{new}} = 18.1670 + 12.5 - 30 = 30.6670 - 30 = 0.667\text{ N}$$
Since $R_{\text{new}} > 0$, the resultant has magnitude $0.667\text{ N}$ directed upwards perpendicular to $ABC$.
teacher_walkthrough:
Because the new resultant is purely perpendicular to the line $ABC$, its component along $ABC$ must vanish:
$$\Sigma F_x = 0 \implies 25\cos 30^\circ - F\cos 40^\circ = 0$$
$$F\cos 40^\circ = 25\cos 30^\circ$$

Divide by $\cos 40^\circ$ to find $F$:
$$F = \frac{25\cos 30^\circ}{\cos 40^\circ} = \frac{25 \times 0.866025}{0.766044} = \frac{21.65063}{0.766044} \approx 28.2628\text{ N} \approx 28.3\text{ N}$$

Compute the new resultant, which is purely the vertical component $\Sigma F_y$:
$$R_{\text{new}} = F\sin 40^\circ + 25\sin 30^\circ - 30$$
Substitute $F = 28.2628\text{ N}$:
$$28.2628 \times \sin 40^\circ = 28.2628 \times 0.642788 = 18.1670\text{ N}$$
$$25\sin 30^\circ = 12.5\text{ N}$$
$$R_{\text{new}} = 18.1670 + 12.5 - 30 = 30.6670 - 30 = 0.667\text{ N}$$
Because this value is positive, the new resultant is $0.667\text{ N}$ directed upwards perpendicular to $ABC$.
